verdict.rationale: Alloy is a fraud and identity decisioning SaaS that runs ML models (Fraud Signal), so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of an opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-use control for model training. The only related item describes Alloy's own ML model adapting to threats, which says nothing about whether customers can exclude their data from training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
